dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You don't exactly strike me as someone who's made bank...

dialogues.speaker: Kamenka
dialogues.text: This... Well this is but a simple periodic adjustment! The market's whims are as the tides, or so they say...

dialogues.speaker: Kamenka
dialogues.text: But it's exactly at times like these that an overabundance of caution is not the play! Trust me, you'll make your millions back in stocks, just like me!

dialogues.speaker: Kamenka
dialogues.text: As long as we can get ten more foo— I mean, ten more strategic investors like yourself, we'll be back in the game in no time!
